metadata.description: Test model for the FPV Vehicle: the Pilot arms at 0.25 s, takes off from the field, hovers, then in angle mode flies a 24 deg bank, an 18 deg forward pitch and a yaw turn. The Vehicle block is a Model Reference to "FPV Vehicle". Scopes are on the Telemetry sheet; Assert blocks on the Tests sheet check arming, the climb, each manoeuvre, the estimators and the battery (npm run obliq:test -- "FPV Demo Flight").
